latest_release.body:
**Previous release: [1.4.257](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.257)** — Smoother long chats, saved browser feedback and better dictation.

## Smoother workspaces, restored phone scrolling & Copilot Chat ✨

Orca 1.4.258 cuts pauses when opening large workspace collections, moving windows and changing the layout. Local usage updates do less work on the process handling your keystrokes, helping Chat UI and terminal users keep working while usage refreshes.

- 📱 **Scroll phone chats again:** On chat pages served by the desktop, swipe through messages and sideways through wide code blocks. Pinch with two fingers to resize chat text without zooming the whole page.
- 💬 **Use GitHub Copilot in Chat:** Choose **Launch chat** to stream replies, inspect tool output and review file diffs in a conversation you can reopen after restarting Orca.
- ⌨️ **Start Pi with your chosen model and thinking level:** The terminal launcher applies your model choice and offers reasoning effort before you send the first prompt.
- 🗂️ **Add projects with fewer steps:** Browse a folder, clone a URL or create a project directly from **Add project**. Switch machines inside the menu; from **New worktree**, it starts with your selected **Run on** host.

## Highlights

- **Keep conversations moving:** Usage-limit **Hand Off to Another Agent** includes the full saved conversation. Generated images stay beside the final answer, and closing a window with a replying chat uses the running-work confirmation. Answer worker permission prompts from the coordinator, with pending requests above the composer and receipts in conversation order.
- **Browse, review and open files:** Extensions are enabled by default in **Settings → Browser**. Git Graph reduces repeated work while scrolling and paging; idle editors stop polling copy hints. Unsupported document tabs offer **Open with default app**, downloading a copy first for SSH or paired-host files.
- **Switch Claude accounts remotely:** Under **Ask**, a phone or CLI switch resumes terminal sessions on the selected account without a desktop dialog. Busy sessions finish their turn first; **Never restart** still keeps them as they are.
- **Read clearer phone code and history:** Phone pages gain syntax colours, pinned diff gutters and PR-state icons. Session History finds compressed Codex archives, OMP profiles and larger OpenCode 2 sessions.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Copilot Chat:** Requires Copilot CLI **1.0.88+** and sign-in. Models appear after starting; plans without a model choice use **Auto**. Session History import into Chat is not supported yet. Avoid switching a chat’s session to allow-all in an external terminal: that permission setting persists when reopened, even if Orca shows **Ask**.
- **Phone updates:** The desktop supplies updated phone web pages; it does not replace the installed native app. New native iOS builds from this source require **iOS 16.4+**. If a tab says **Update mobile**, update the phone app and reconnect.

## What's Changed

### Workspaces, performance & desktop UI

*Large-profile saves, workspace startup, project admission, localization and desktop layout changes.*

* perf(persistence): window moves and UI edits no longer re-save the whole profile by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40627
* Avoid repeated repository hydration during large workspace startup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41088
* Avoid sorting all folders when resolving one workspace host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41248
* fix(activity): keep quiet agents with an open terminal listed as No recent update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40952
* style(menus): roomier rows, lighter icons, solid surface by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/40000
* style(new-workspace): icon-only Create From tabs and shorter Create button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/41036
* style

detail.readme:
Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

The AI Orchestrator for 100x builders.
Run Claude Code, Codex, and any other coding agent in parallel, each in its own worktree. Chat or terminal, on your laptop or in the cloud, with diffs, a browser, and a CLI in one app.

Download Orca

## Features
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Run Anywhere Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host, or give a worktree its own cloud VM. Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/ways-to-run)
### Mobile App Pair Orca with the mobile app to get pinged when an agent needs you, reply in chat, and keep work moving on any of your machines when you are away from your desk. [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) · [Android APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/mobile)
### Review AI Output Review diffs, leave notes on exact changed lines, and send focused feedback back to an agent. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/annotate-ai-diff)
### Git Integration Draft commit messages and pull requests from the diff, then send failing checks or PR review comments back to an agent to fix. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/commit-push)
### Parallel Worktrees Quickly split tasks into isolated environments, so multiple agents can work side by side without interfering with each other. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/worktrees)
### Design Mode Click any element in Orca's browser to copy its HTML, styles, and selector, then paste it into your agent's chat. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/browser/design-mode)
### GitHub & Linear, Native See your GitHub and Linear tasks in one place, and start a workspace for each when you're ready to build. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/linear)
### Orca CLI Anything you can do in Orca, your agents can do too: create worktrees, start workers, drive the browser and desktop apps, and schedule automations, all from the command line. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview)
### Plugins Themes, editors, languages, and panels from the community, installed in a click. [Browse plugins →](https://orca.dev/plugins)
### Split Anything Put agents, terminals, browsers, and diffs side by side in split panes shaped to the task. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/tabs-panes-splits)
**Also in the box:** - **[Drag Files to Agents](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/file-explorer)**: drag files from the explorer, or images from your desktop, straight into an agent's prompt. - **[Jump Anywhere](https://orca.dev/docs/model/quick-open)**: one shortcut jumps to any workspace or tab across every repo and host. - **[Rich Previews](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/viewers)**: open images, PDFs, and Markdown right in the workspace, next to the agent that made them. - **[Mobile Emulator](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview#mobile-emulator)**: run an iOS Simulator or Android emulator beside your agent, and let it tap, type, and check its own work. - **[Dictation](https://orca.dev/docs/settings#voice)**: press a shortcut and talk. Orca types what you say into the agent's prompt or terminal. - **[Usage & Accounts](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/usage-tracking)**: see how much of your agent limits you've used and when they reset, and switch accounts without logging out. - **[Automations](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/automations)**: schedule prompts to run on any repo: nightly dependency bumps, weekly triage, flaky-test sweeps. - **[Computer Use](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/computer-use)**: when there's no CLI or API, agents can see and drive desktop apps and external browsers. - **And many, many more**: we ship daily, so this list is perpetually behind. The [changelog](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) is the real feature list. --- ## Supported Agents Works with **any CLI agent** — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Orca.

Claude Code   Codex   Grok   Cursor   GitHub Copilot   Muse   DeepSeek Harness   ZCode   OpenCode   MiMo Code   Amp   OpenClaude   Antigravity   Pi   oh-my-pi   Hermes Agent   Devin   Goose   Auggie   Autohand Code   Charm   Cline   CodeBuddy   Codebuff   Freebuff   Command Code   Continue   Droid   Kilocode   Kimi   Kiro   Mistral Vibe   Qwen Code   Rovo Dev   + any CLI agent

--- ## Install ### Desktop — macOS, Windows, Linux - **[Download from orca.dev](https://orca.dev/download)** - Or grab a build directly: [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-arm64.dmg) · [macOS Intel](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-x64.dmg) · [Windows (.exe)](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-windows-setup.exe) · [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-linux.AppImage) · [All builds](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest) _Or via a package manager:_ ```bash # macOS (Homebrew) # Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask. brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Upgrade an existing install brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc # Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source yay -S stably-orca-bin ``` ### Mobile App — iOS, Android Pair with your desktop app to monitor and steer your agents from your phone. - **iOS:** [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) - **Android:** [Download APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Install guide](https://orca.dev/docs/android-apk) --- ## Community & Support - **Discord:** Join the community on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/fzjDKHxv8Q)**. - **Twitter / X:** Follow **[@orca_build](https://x.com/orca_build)** for updates and announcements. - **WeChat:** Scan to join an Orca community WeChat group. - **Feedback & Ideas:** We ship fast. Missing something? [Request a new feature](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/issues). - **Privacy:** See the [privacy & telemetry docs](https://orca.dev/docs/telemetry) for what anonymous usage data Orca collects and how to opt out. - **Show Support:** [Star](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) this repo to follow along with our daily ships. --- ## Developing Want to contribute or run locally? See our [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.

## Signed Builds Windows code signing sponsored/provided by [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). ## License Orca is free and open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
